canonical_statement: For Borel probability measures mu_n and mu on finite-dimensional real coordinate space, mu_n converges weakly to mu if and only if, for every real coefficient vector t, the pushforwards of mu_n under x |-> sum_i t_i x_i converge weakly to the corresponding pushforward of mu.
